MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.en: Do you remember how Mirabel, Anna, Elsa and you used to be friends?

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.en: You know, that's funny. I was just thinking about that the other day. We had SO much fun together.

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.en: You're all awesome.

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.original_cz: Jste všichni úžasní.

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.en: You're all back in the Valley.

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.original_cz: Všichni jste zpátky v Údolí.

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.en: Well, why not?

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.en: Oh, thanks. You are too!

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.original_cz: Díky. Ty taky!

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.en: Anna, Elsa and Kristoff are fixing the <ActivityItem>Madrigal Table</ActivityItem> and making new chairs. I was hoping you could help too. We want it to be a present for Mirabel.
MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.cz: Anna, Elsa a Kristoff opravují <ActivityItem>Madrigalův stůl</ActivityItem> a vyrábějí nové židle. Doufala jsem, že byste taky mohli pomoci. Chceme to jako dárek pro Mirabel.

MirabelUpdate_Moana/Moana_VLG_Mira_040_V.en: Sure! Hmm... Oh! Mirabel had this beautiful cloth she used to cover the table. I can make a new one out of an old sail.
